text: Rank known author IDs by distinct 2021–2024 snapshot works on which they list Columbia or an included child, descending then author ID ascending. Retain exactly 80; all snapshot work types count. Classify using those same affiliated works: modal field from primary work topics, then modal subfield within that field, excluding missing topics and breaking ties by classification ID. Links count distinct snapshot works on which both selected authors appear, irrespective of each author's affiliation on the shared work. Cross-field refers to different assigned author fields, not a work's interdisciplinarity.

Use radial root → field → subfield → author layout; route each link through the two endpoints’ hierarchy up to their lowest common ancestor, then smooth with D3 curveBundle (default beta 0.86). Thickness is monotone in the square root of shared-work count. Keep isolates visible and distinguish different assigned fields using rust-orange links versus gray for the same field.
